text: Pay with Coins: Buildings line says 'Next: Farm, 25 wood, 10 stone, or 2,160 coins' while the coins button says 'Buy Farm (1,764)'. Two different coin prices for the same farm on one screen.

Order works on a Stranger member (Dave Davies: 'I hardly know you, but you lead Northernfield. I'll gather 10 wood.'). But at 5 fps the pawn walks out of reach between walkto and the click; the Order button vanishes and the click lands on nothing. Took 3 tries over two pawns.
